name: Heavy Equipment Storage Tent
visual_identity: Reinforced, low-profile khaki tent used for heavy tool housing; interior shows the orange rock saw, pneumatic jackhammers, and sledge hammers neatly organized on heavy-duty rubber mats; several spare fuel canisters and rolls of white plaster burlap are stacked in the corner.
notes: Character Paleontologist 6 is assigned to this area to organize gear.
